newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Policeman dies in Nigeria soccer stampede.
newsitem.headline: Policeman dies in Nigeria soccer stampede.

text.p: A policeman died and many were injured when jubilant Nigerian soccer fans surged towards the stadium exits on Saturday after a World Cup game, local newspapers said on Monday.

The daily Vanguard paper quoted sources at Lagos General Hospital as saying the police sergeant had been taken to the mortuary after being crushed to death at the match. Other newspapers carried the same report.

Celebrating Nigeria's 2-1 victory over Guinea in the World Cup qualifying match, thousands of spectators rushed to leave after the final whistle, trampling many people underfoot, witnesses at the stadium said.
The death toll was initially reported to have been considerably higher, after a number of bodies were seen being carted away from the scene.
But hospital sources said that most of the people brought for treatment had been knocked unconscious and later revived.
